text_block_list.text:
Midway through summer camp— Winning Ticket 
gave it her all in training every single 
day.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm gonna give it everything 
I've got and run a race that fires 
everybody up again!

Then, one day, it was decided that she 
would participate in a tandem training 
session with another Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Uryaaaahhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Yaaa~~~~h!!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Whoaa... Both of them are running 
amazingly!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
That girl over there is Winning Ticket, 
isn't she?! Good luck to both of you!

Before we knew it, spectators were 
overflowing the area, generating an 
excitement hard to believe for a mere 
training session.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Thank you all for the support!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! I never imagined getting cheered on 
even at our training camp!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if those people are also fans who 
got super fired up watching the Derby...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Thinking about it like that, I feel like 
I'm getting totally fired up—like a fire 
is burning inside me!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I've reached one dream called the Derby, 
but I'm gonna keep on running!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"So, I have to run in lots and lots of 
races that move people even more!"
choice_data_list:
Let's work hard in training to make that 
happen!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!! The Twinkle Series starts right 
here~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's do some intense, hardcore 
training today!!
choice_data_list: Then it's time for long-distance swimming!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
O-One hundred full sprints on the beach?! 
Eeeeeeek~~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
B-But still! I totally felt your fired-up 
spirit, Trainer!! We just gotta do this!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOO!! Let's do our beeeest!! Fight 
on!!

Having psyched herself back up, Winning 
Ticket dashed off toward the sandy beach.

Even after that, our all-out "summer 
training camp" with Winning Ticket 
continued on.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: "Wait, long-distance swimming!? Whaaaat!?"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
B-But still! If I manage to swim all the 
way through, I feel like I won't just 
level up once, but like a hundred times 
over!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOO!! I'm gonna swim with everything 
I've gooooot!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: GUUUUUUUUUUUUUUTS!!
(SPLAAAAAAASH!!)

Even after that, our all-out "summer 
training camp" with Winning Ticket 
continued on.
